children: BRASILIA, Sept 10 (Reuters) - Services activity in Brazil grew 0.9% in July from July 2025 (BRSERV=ECI), statistics agency IBGE said. Economists had forecast a median rise of +1.1% in a Reuters poll.
Services activity remained stable from June after seasonal adjustments.
